name: shengyu
description: 声屿 — 原创音乐流媒体原型

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @shengyu/api" "npm run dev -w @shengyu/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shengyu/api && npm run build -w @shengyu/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shengyu/api && npm run test -w @shengyu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shengyu/api && npm run typecheck -w @shengyu/web
